final_qi.question: In which year was the individual who first described the case of FMPP born?
final_qi.long_answer: The condition now referred to as FMPP (fibrodysplasia /myositis ossificans progressiva) was first reported in the medical literature by the French physician Guy Patin. Patin was born in 1601, so 1601 is the birth year of the individual who originally described a case of FMPP.

final_answer.long_answer: Familial male-limited precocious puberty (FMPP, or testotoxicosis) was first reported in 1972 by the Belgian andrologist Freddy H. Comhaire, who described the original affected family. Dr. Comhaire was born in 1943, so 1943 is the birth year of the individual who first documented a case of FMPP.
